title: Make root requirements.txt the single shared test dependency list for CI Smoke and the worker test interpreter
summary: Removed redundant dependency list scripts/dev/worker-test-requirements.txt, making root requirements.txt the single shared test dependency list for CI Smoke and the worker test interpreter. requirements.txt now declares cryptography, pyyaml, pydantic>=2, httpx, and fastapi. CI Smoke runs pip install --upgrade pip followed by pip install -r requirements.txt. scripts/dev/ensure_worker_test_python.py installs requirements.txt and services/control-plane/bff/requirements.txt in a single pip invocation and probes psycopg. Removed unused PANTHEON_WORKER_TEST_PYTHON_DIR override in sync-dev-root.sh.

real_build.command: T=$(mktemp -d); python3 -B scripts/dev/ensure_worker_test_python.py --root "$PWD" --parent "$T"; "$T/current/bin/python3" -c 'import psycopg, fastapi, pytest'; rm -rf "$T"
